Input: Poor RSRP coverage
Output: Causes: Poor RSRP coverage. Solutions: Adjust antenna tilt and increase cell power. Steps: Identify sectors with RSRP below -110 dBm using OMC counters; Reduce mechanical downtilt by 2-3 degrees to extend coverage radius; Increase DL transmission power by 3 dB (verify EIRP regulatory limits first). Impact: Resolves coverage hole and reduces call drop rate significantly

Input: High interference (SINR<0)
Output: Causes: High interference (SINR<0). Solutions: Run interference audit and optimize power control. Steps: Pull the inter-cell interference matrix from the OMC dashboard; Identify top-3 interfering cells by PCI and SINR heatmap; Reduce aggressor cell Tx power by 2 dB to lower interference floor. Impact: Improves SINR by 3-6 dB and boosts user throughput by 20-40%

Input: HO failure
Output: Causes: HO failure. Solutions: Tune handover parameters and clean the neighbor list. Steps: Export neighbor relation table and flag missing or stale entries; Reduce the A3 offset from its current value by 2 dB; Shorten Time-to-Trigger (TTT) from 320 ms to 160 ms. Impact: Restores HO success rate above 95% and eliminates cell-edge call drops

Input: PRB saturation
Output: Causes: PRB saturation. Solutions: Activate carrier aggregation and load balancing. Steps: Enable Carrier Aggregation to add a secondary carrier on the overloaded cell; Enable MLB to offload UEs to adjacent lightly-loaded cells; Lower PRB utilization alarm threshold so MLB triggers earlier. Impact: Reduces PRB load by 25-35% and restores average user throughput

Input: Transport congestion
Output: Causes: Transport congestion. Solutions: Reroute traffic and upgrade backhaul QoS settings. Steps: Check transport link utilization on the affected gNB backhaul port; Reroute to alternate path via BGP/OSPF metric adjustment; Apply DSCP remarking to prioritize 5G user-plane (GTP-U) traffic. Impact: Reduces latency from over 100 ms to under 30 ms, stops RLC retransmissions

Input: Missing neighbor relation
Output: Causes: Missing neighbor relation. Solutions: Run ANR audit and add missing neighbor cells. Steps: Trigger ANR scan on the affected cell; Cross-check with cell topology map for geographically adjacent gNBs; Manually add missing NCRs in the OMC interface. Impact: Eliminates ping-pong HO failures and reduces call drops by 30-50%

Input: Coverage hole
Output: Causes: Coverage hole. Solutions: Deploy a small cell or repeater in the coverage gap. Steps: Confirm the coverage hole via drive test or UE measurement reports; Identify suitable indoor or outdoor small cell deployment sites; Temporarily adjust adjacent macrocell tilt to partially fill the gap. Impact: Permanently resolves coverage gap, improves indoor RSRP by 15-20 dB

Input: PCI collision
Output: Causes: PCI collision. Solutions: Reassign PCI to eliminate the collision or confusion. Steps: Extract the current PCI allocation plan from the OMC; Identify conflicting PCIs within 3-cell reuse distance (mod-3 collision); Assign a new PCI from available pool respecting mod-3 and mod-30 rules. Impact: Eliminates HO confusion and improves cell selection accuracy

Input: UL/DL interference
Output: Causes: UL/DL interference. Solutions: Optimize UL power control and activate interference cancellation. Steps: Set UL SINR target to 5 dB and enable closed-loop power control; Enable IRC (Interference Rejection Combining) on affected cells; Check for rogue UEs transmitting at max power causing UL interference. Impact: Improves UL BLER from above 15% to below 5%, boosts MOS by 0.5-1.0

Output: Causes: PRB congestion. Solutions: Load balance users and activate carrier aggregation. Steps: Identify top PRB-consuming UEs via scheduler statistics; Apply QoS throttling to best-effort traffic on the mMTC slice; Activate 5G CA combining n78 and n28 bands for extra capacity. Impact: Frees 20-30% PRB and restores average user throughput to normal

Output: Causes: Low SINR. Solutions: Optimize antenna tilt and update beamforming weights. Impact: Improves average SINR by 3-5 dB with throughput gains of 15-25%

Input: Overshooting cell
Output: Causes: Overshooting cell. Solutions: Increase downtilt to contain the cell footprint. Steps: Increase mechanical downtilt by 3-5 degrees on the overshooting sector; Reduce DL Tx power by 3 dB to shrink the coverage footprint; Update neighbor lists of cells newly exposed after coverage shrink. Impact: Eliminates interference to 2-4 adjacent cells and reduces call drop rate

Input: PDU session drop
Output: Causes: PDU session drop. Solutions: Check UPF path health and tune session timer parameters. Steps: Verify UPF instance health and check N3/N9 interface status; Extend PDU session inactivity timer from 30 seconds to 120 seconds; Inspect SMF logs for unexpected AMF-triggered session releases. Impact: Eliminates unexpected data session interruptions for affected users
